segments.name: Topical immunomodulators
segments.description: Develops non-systemic, non-biologic topical immunomodulators for inflammatory skin disease, with drug and medical device products.
segments.evidence: We manage our operations as a single reportable segment for the purposes of assessing performance and making operating decisions.

revenueModel.text: Commercial partners pay to license or buy the company's cleared medical device products, while the company focuses on drug development.
revenueModel.evidence: Our current business model is to license and/or sell medical device products through commercial partners, without significant capital commitments from us, which allows us to focus our internal efforts on drug development.
